If a product does not work out for you, your options depend on the reason for return.

For change of mind:

Online purchases: Return within 30 days of delivery.
In-store purchases: Return within 14 days for a full refund, or within 30 days for an exchange or store credit.
Items must be in original condition, unwashed, with all tags attached.

How to return:

Online orders: Use the free prepaid courier label included with your order.
In-store purchases: Return to any Barkers store with proof of purchase.
Online orders can also be returned in-store with the original payment card.

For faulty items:

Barkers will assess and may offer a repair, replacement, refund, or store credit.

Processing times:

Allow up to 5 business days for processing in Australia.
Refunds may take a few business days to appear on your statement.
Afterpay refunds can take up to 10 business days.
